_note: SYNTHETIC scenarios (no real company facts). Each case lists counts of VERIFIED evidence per category and the classification a human SDR would expect. They test the scoring/routing rules, not live research.

cases.name: agent-builder-with-need
cases.why: Deploys agents, states an observability problem, no internal tool.

cases.name: model-provider-with-internal-tooling (Mistral-like)
cases.why: Strong technical relevance, own tracing/evaluation platform, documented LangChain integration.

cases.name: already-uses-third-party-tool
cases.why: Technical fit but an incumbent tool lowers buyer fit; validate before pitching.

cases.name: little-evidence
cases.why: Too little verified evidence: low confidence, not a rejection.

cases.name: no-evidence-at-all
cases.why: Missing information is not negative evidence.

cases.name: no-ai-activity
cases.why: Evidence exists but shows no agentic AI activity.

cases.name: strong-tech-weak-buyer
cases.why: Builds its own tooling and no partnership angle: do not pitch.

cases.name: ecosystem-player-no-need
cases.why: Documented integration and model provider; no stated need.
